jamie_g: Quick Q — I toggled my 401k contribution from Roth to pre-tax in the portal yesterday evening. Not sure if I hit payroll cutoff. Will this take effect this pay or next? cc @sam_benefits

sam_benefits: Hi @jamie_g 95 usually changes after cutoff apply next pay. When did you make the change?

jamie_g: 2026-04-12 19:05 PT. Portal said "update successful" but no confirmation email.

payroll-bot: payroll-bot: Payroll feed for 04/15 run processed at 04/15 04:00 UTC. Checking deductions: jamie_g shows 401k_pre_tax $150 scheduled, no Roth deduction for this period.

maria_hr: We have a vendor migration this month; sometimes mid-cycle syncs cause duplicates. If a duplicate deduction occurs we can request a vendor reversal or payroll net adjustment. Contact payroll@redwood.com.

sam_benefits: Thanks @maria_hr. Action: @jamie_g please DM screenshot of portal success. If payroll shows a duplicate we'll file BEN-ADJ with payroll.

alex_k: Had this happen last month during a vendor cutover. Payroll manual refund was fastest.

jamie_g: Sent screenshot via DM to @sam_benefits. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
